questions.question:

3.\({T}^2=4 \pi^2 {r}^3\)4.\({T}^2=\dfrac{4 \pi^2 {r}}{{G M}^2}\)
questions.explanation:
Hint:Use dimensional analysis. LHS and RHS must have the same dimensions. Step:Examine each option.
